profile.headline: Software Engineer at Citizens Bank
profile.summary:
I am a graduate student pursuing Masters in Information Technology Management from University of Texas at Dallas. My specialization is in Business Intelligence.

I am a Project Management Intern at Innovative Electronics Corporation. My day to day work includes communicating with the clients and gathering the requirements. I am also linked with reviewing the availability for the components with the specification and coordinating with the Purchasing Department. Along with that I design the Gantt Chart for the whole process and takes care if the project meets all the deadlines.
 
I have also worked as a Research Assistant in Project Management Department of Executive Education Program - University of Texas at Dallas. As a Research Assistant I have gained qualities like Leadership and various Management skills. Also I am preparing for CAPM (Certified Associate in Project Management). Thus I have developed skills required to lead as a Professional.

I have also done an Internship at Jayatma Informatics Pvt. Ltd. as a Software Developer. I have developed a Learning Management System using PHP and MySQL as database.

I have worked on a Real Time data provided by VCA Animal Hospitals as a part of my Marketing Analytics Class. I developed a model using techniques like Survival Analysis, Elasticity Modeling, Regression Technique and Market Basket Analysis. This analysis improved helped them improve their revenue by 4%.

Along with that I have developed a Migration Prediction Model using SAS Enterprise Miner which predicts whether the person will migrate or not depending upon different attributes like Income, Age and Occupation. I have also developed a Billboard Exposure Model by writing a SAS Code which predicts the probability of a billboard Exposure. I have also worked using Macros in Excel and did a Simulation Project for Operations Management.

positions.title: Operations Analyst
positions.description:
I was a part of the Operations Performance and Strategy department and my work was to provide the Operations Insights for the incoming flight operations data. I used to write R code to create tone metrics on Employee Sentiments within Employee reporting tools and derive different insights based on the results generated.  My project made an impact on analyzing the data which we receive daily.

I used Infoview, QuickBase and Excel to employee response process to aid in employee engagement. Along with that I used to help with the ad-hoc data requests from internal customers to support Airlines Safety Assurances. I have automated the safety reports for different internal clients using Tableau by generating stories and dashboards. Along with that I also used to perform day-to-day database maintenance for the daily reported irregularities by the southwest employees. I also received a shoot out in our monthly newsletter for my hard work and dedication.

positions.title: Project Management Intern
positions.description:
As a Project Management Intern I am responsible for collecting and reviewing customer requirements and specifications for electrical and electro-mechanical assemblies to meet the manufacturing capabilities and tolerances. Analyzing and reporting trends in the business, market research and data analysis were also among the work assigned to me. 

I also work closely with the Purchasing department and help them to verify the Customer Quotes and Purchasing Order. I also take an active part in Purchasing the Components which are required for the PCB Assembly. I contact different suppliers and obtain quotations for the components and send the Purchasing Order to the supplier with the best quotation. I solve complex problems using advanced excel and analyzing the processed data and generating reports using Tableau.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Used to work for the Executive Education department of University of Texas at Dallas with Project Management department. All of my work was done by applying project management techniques from the PMBOK.

I used to provide technical assistance to the department; oversee the creation, maintenance and edition of the courses for our executive students; perform reporting and analysis; and fixing IT issues. I used to generate and develop the reports for the Classroom management system using Crystal Reports and maintained the database for all the collected historical data using Microsoft SQL Server and MS Access.

positions.description: Worked as a trainee at Jayatma Informatics Pvt Ltd. As a Trainee I did my Academic Project in PHP using My SQL as the backend. The project was a web based system called Learning Management System.

projects.title: Learning Management System
projects.description: It is a Web based system which manages learners, keep track of their progress and performance across all types of activities in centralized manner. Learning Management System plays a structural role of Administrating, Documenting, Tracking and Evaluating learning program through a software application. It provides the proper platform for the interaction between students and teachers, increasing the communications facility between them. This helps in increasing the bond between the student and teacher.

projects.title: Migration Prediction Model Using SAS Enterprise Miner
projects.description:
In recent years, high migration rate is observed in India. Government statistics show that the migration rate during 1991-2001 was as high as 22%. Various factors contributed to this migration. 
The most common factor was employment. This has in turn, created pressure on others who are in the same job market. Lack of rural employment and fragmentation of land holdings, were the major problems faced by rural Indians.
The above issue led to our study, through which we wanted to identify some pattern based on the parameters that are associated with an individual migration. Such a prediction tool would be of great help to the government and regulatory authorities.

The core idea within our study is to identify the key drivers of migration in India. Through this project, we aim to give the following information: 

•	Whether a person will migrate or not

Techniques used to build a model and analyze its results:
•	Logit Regression
•	Decision Tree
•	Neural Network
